title: 压缩的代价：事实幻觉的率失真极限
summary: 论文提出覆盖-压缩模型，用信息论证明有限记忆下已观测事实的有损存储是幻觉的独立来源，给出率失真下界，区分压缩失真与覆盖缺失，并用模拟和事实注入实验验证。
summary_en: The paper introduces a coverage-compression model of factual recall, proving an information-theoretic lower bound that separates lossy compression of observed facts from missing coverage, and validates the predicted signatures with simulations and fact-injection probes in modern language models.
